title: FAST-PETase: an AI-engineered enzyme degrades PET waste
summary: A machine-learning model suggested PETase mutations, then tested on 51 post-consumer containers, fibers and fabrics. FAST-PETase degrades PET below 50 °C, in some cases down to monomers within 24 hours; production at scale and environmental use still needed development.

evidence.tested: FAST-PETase was tested on 51 post-consumer containers, fibers and fabrics, degrading PET below 50 °C, in some cases to monomers within 24 hours.
evidence.unknown: Scale-up, field use at polluted sites and cost are not demonstrated, and the work covers only PET.
